correctness.evidence: The scientific framing is materially false: Rao, TCS 601 (2015), DOI 10.1016/j.tcs.2015.07.026, proves 2-abelian cubes avoidable on a binary alphabet by an infinite construction. The filed finite words are not asserted invalid.

originality.evidence: A 200000-bit existence witness is subsumed by the 2015 infinite binary construction; the claimed finite frontier is not novel. A particular bit string or greedy-search log does not restore the advertised scientific novelty.

value.evidence: After infinite binary avoidability is known, doubling a 2011 finite benchmark does not advance the threshold. Search-specific obstruction logs have benchmark/debugging use only.
